name: Throwing shield
source: Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 33, Adventurer's Armory pg. 5, Ultimate Combat pg. 145, Ultimate Equipment pg. 21
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 33, Adventurer's Armory pg. 5, Ultimate Combat pg. 145, Ultimate Equipment pg. 21
Statistics
Cost +50 gp Weight —
Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range 20 ft.; Type B; Special performance, trip
Category Ranged; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Thrown
Description
This shield is designed for throwing and has specially designed straps that allow you to unclasp it as a free action. Tower shields cannot be throwing shields. Neither a shield’s enhancement bonus to AC nor its shield spikes apply on your attack or damage rolls. A throwing shield can’t be disarmed.
